issues.description: v3-beta default speaker is 'shubh' in code but 'aditya' in all documentation and PR description
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' for bulbul:v3-beta, while the module docstring, class docstring, README, and PR text all declare 'aditya'. Pick one source of truth and reconcile. Silent doc/code drift will mislead the next maintainer and any user relying on documented defaults.

issues.description: 'Parameter ignored' warnings compare against default values instead of detecting explicit user input
issues.detail: Warnings like 'pitch is ignored for {model}' fire on params.pitch != 0.0 (and similar for temperature/loudness). A user explicitly passing the default gets no warning; one who never set it but whose default differs from the model's gets a spurious one. Use model_fields_set or an explicit sentinel.

issues.description: voice_id is never validated against the selected model's allowed speakers tuple
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a speakers tuple per model and SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist, but __init__ never checks voice_id membership. A v2 speaker sent to v3-beta fails at API time with a server error instead of a clear client-side ValueError at construction. The data is there; wire the check.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT connect_kwargs with no justification
issues.detail: Previously the connect payload included input_audio_codec=self._input_audio_codec; the refactor removes it without comment. If the SDK still consumes this field, it's a silent regression for existing saarika:v2.5 and saaras:v2.5 deployments. Restore it or document why it's now implicit.

issues.description: Pace validation is split between Pydantic Field bounds and per-model silent clamping
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace ge=0.3, le=3.0 at the Pydantic layer; __init__ then silently clamps to model-specific pace_range with only a warning. The precondition is ambiguous: callers cannot tell whether out-of-range pace is rejected, clamped, or accepted. Pick one: narrow the Field to the model's range or raise on violation.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently returns v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: The helper accepts an unconstrained str and falls back to v2 speakers on miss, with no diagnostic. A caller validating against a misspelled model gets a plausible but wrong list, masking the typo. Raise on unknown model (consistent with __init__) or return Optional[List[str]].

synthesis.summary: The refactor to data-driven ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig tables is the right shape — capability becomes a value to look up rather than substring sniffing on model names. The panel unanimously agrees the execution is incomplete in detail: the v3-beta default speaker contradicts its own documentation, 'parameter ignored' warnings infer user intent from value equality with defaults (false positives and negatives both), voice_id is never validated against the speakers tuple the config carries, and pace bounds are declared in two places that disagree. Two reviewers also flagged a silent drop of input_audio_codec from STT connect_kwargs that reads as a behavior change disguised as a refactor. Land it after fixing the speaker default, the warning sentinel logic, voice validation, the codec drop, and the pace bounds duplication.
